response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on delivery across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, genuine open-source credibility (founder of GISCollective, multiple D-language libraries, conference talks and workshops), and a completed CS degree. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position and the resume shows no formal people-management, team-lead, or technical project-management experience, no evidence of IT architecture ownership, UML/modeling, requirements management, or IT security/risk/compliance work. Most decisively, the posting requires German at C1 minimum while the candidate self-reports 'Basic' German — a hard blocker for a client-facing advisory role in the German market. He would be a compelling senior/staff engineer hire, but is not currently a fit for Head of Development.
strengths: Deep, broad hands-on engineering experience across many stacks and 15+ years
Strong open-source and Linux orientation; founded and runs an OSS geo-data platform
Proven knowledge-sharing: conference talks, multi-day workshops, courses, mentoring culture
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely disqualifying
No formal team leadership, hiring, or technical project management track record
No demonstrated IT architecture, UML/modeling, requirements management, or security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership / architecture / PM experience
Deep technical breadth and open-source/Linux background
